item.title: North Carolina State Board of Elections rules U.S. Senate candidate is not a resident of NC
item.description: The North Carolina State Board of Elections has upheld a challenge against a candidate in this year's U.S. Senate election.

item.title: Fayetteville may tear down unfinished fire station after report finds major structural issues
item.description: The city hired Allied Building Sciences to assess the project after contractor WB Brawley failed to complete construction within the original 18-month timeline. According to the report, inspectors found issues with the substructure, walls, roof, and multiple building systems.

item.title: NCDMV changes online appointments to limit scheduling to a week in advance
item.description: As the North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles continues taking steps to improve efficiency and cut wait times, the state has made a change to the timeline for online appointments.
